sources.headline: SentinelOne Beats Q2 Estimates, Issues Soft Earnings Guidance, Shares Slip
SentinelOne Lowers FY2027 Adj EPS Guidance from $0.32-$0.38 to $0.30-$0.32 vs $0.35 Est; Raises FY2027 Sales Guidance from $1.195B-$1.205B to $1.202B-$1.207B vs $1.205B Est
SentinelOne Sees Q3 Adj EPS $0.08-$0.09 vs $0.11 Est; Sees Sales $309.000M-$311.000M vs $309.442M Est
SentinelOne Q2 Adj. EPS $0.08 Beats $0.07 Estimate, Sales $291.981M Beat $290.250M Estimate

key_numbers: FY27 adj EPS guide lowered to $0.30-$0.32 from $0.32-$0.38
FY27 sales guide raised to $1.202B-$1.207B from $1.195B-$1.205B
Q3 adj EPS guide $0.08-$0.09 vs $0.11 est
fields.observable_in_3_sessions: If the bearish reading is right, S stock will likely continue to slide or underperform the market over the next three sessions, possibly testing lower support levels.
fields.falsifier: A strong rebound in S stock price within three sessions, closing above the prior session's close, would contradict the bearish direction claim.
fields.already_priced_note: The after-hours move of -6.17% aligns with the bearish direction claim, but the market may have moved more than the fundamental content alone justifies.
fields.summary: SentinelOne beat Q2 estimates but issued soft Q3 and FY27 earnings guidance, lowering its full-year EPS outlook while raising sales guidance. The market reacted negatively in after-hours trading, reflecting concerns about profitability despite revenue growth.

note: expectation data, not a forecast: what management SAID, read by a model. Compare with what the market priced before stating a thesis.
